abilities.effect: The sportlebore rapidly multiplies in the host’s stomach, exposing the host to sportlebore infestation.
abilities.name: Mimic Food
abilities.trigger: A creature eats food the sportlebore is hidden within

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

stages.name: Stage 4
stages.text: 4d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Fortitude save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: An effect with this trait applies one or more diseases. A disease is typically an affliction.

hazard.description: A sportlebore hides amid victuals on a plate of food or within a pack of trail rations.
hazard.disable: A creature that notices the sportlebore can remove it from the food it’s hidden within automatically as an Interact action.
hazard.name: Sportlebore
